build_generate_and_save_artifact: build and save a generated artifact for a TensorFlow dataset by loading it and extracting data
create_multi_process_map: create a multiprocessing pool to apply a worker function across multiple TensorFlow datasets
create_multi_thread_map: create a thread pool executor to apply a worker function across multiple TensorFlow datasets
run_multi_process_run: run a main function using absl.app.run with multiprocess-safe flags
summarize_get_full_names: summarize how to list all TensorFlow dataset builder names for a given set of datasets
